accuracy.evidence: Teaches bonds to 10 per CCSS K.OA.4 and NC Y1 despite catalog title 'Number bonds to 9'; evidence items are make-10 partners. Pairs 1+9…5+5 covered in lab and items.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets same-number again, teen overshoot, digit-sticking (55), forcing 9+2=10. Feedback names each slip.

lab_distinct.evidence: Lab is partner-to-10 with empty ten-frame spaces and snap bonds; not teen composition and not general addition-in-any-order.

lab_teaches.evidence: Empty-space count reveals the partner; pairs/equations/snap practise retrieval after the discovery.

predictions.evidence: Wrong options 7 empty for 7 full, partner 4 for 4, partner 9 for 9 — lab then shows the true complement.

challenge_feedback.evidence: why() messages for same/teen/half/eleven/digits/force explain the exact arithmetic slip.

readability.evidence: Kid lines are short and concrete (counters, empty spaces). Adult clarifies catalog name vs bonds-to-10 curriculum.

no_filler.evidence: No template filler; every sentence teaches a pair or a mistake.

mobile.evidence: Large choice tiles and lbtn twins; phone-friendly ten-frame.

accessibility.evidence: Button path for fill/empty/pairs/eq/snap; live aria-label; challenge status region.

sources: UK NC Y1 number bonds to 10
